name: 68134 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68134 (Omaha) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68134 (Omaha) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68134 (Omaha) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
